facts.label: Cost scaling
facts.value: Base cost × 2^(target level − 1), each resource rounded down to whole units.

facts.label: Construction and manufacturing time
facts.value: Raw duration is divided by 2^completed Nanite Factory level, in addition to Robotics or Shipyard acceleration. Building upgrades retain the universe’s construction adjustment; manufacturing rounds each unit down to whole seconds with a one-second minimum. Research is unaffected.

facts.label: Industrial lock
facts.value: Factory upgrades and demolition cannot overlap any unfinished manufacturing on this planet, including waiting ships, defenses and missiles. Self-upgrades use the old completed Nanite level.
